remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated modern home, offering 3 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms in a highly sought-after location.  Step inside to find a bright, open layout designed for today's lifestyle. The kitchen features sleek finishes, modern cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances, flowing seamlessly into the dining and living areas-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Large windows allow natural light to fill the home, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The location is hard to beat-walk to the train and nearby places of worship, and enjoy being just minutes from downtown shopping, dining, and entertainment. With its modern updates and convenient setting, this home truly offers the best of comfort and accessibility.  Don't miss the opportunity to make this special home yours!
